name: Mistral
h1: Mistral ARR: $400M in Sovereign, Open-Weight AI.
intro: Mistral went from ~$16M annualized at the end of 2024 to a $400M revenue run rate by January 2026 — roughly 20x in a year — on enterprise API usage and Europe's sovereign-AI buildout. Every reported ARR, funding and valuation number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Sovereign AI Deals Became the Growth Engine.
modelParagraphs: Mistral monetizes three ways: a usage-based API (la Plateforme) with tiered pricing per million tokens across its open-weight model families; Le Chat subscriptions on the consumer side, including Pro and Team plans around the $15–30/month range; and — the fastest-growing slice — custom enterprise and sovereign contracts in which governments and industrials (Airbus, BMW, ASML among the named partners) pay for private deployments and dedicated capacity.

The sovereign-AI positioning is the differentiator: European governments and national champions buy Mistral specifically because its open weights can run in-country and in-house. That drove the enterprise book from ~$20M to $400M annualized in about a year, backed by commitments like €1.2B in Swedish data-center capacity.
revenueMix: Per-token pricing on open-weight model families via La Plateforme.
Private in-country deployments for governments and industrials — the growth engine.
Consumer and team plans at roughly $15–30/month.

faqs.a: Mistral's annualized revenue run rate reached $400 million by January 2026, per Sacra estimates and FT reporting of CEO Arthur Mensch's figures — up from ~$16M at the end of 2024, roughly a 20x year. The company targets €1 billion of revenue for 2026.
From ~$100M annualized in mid-2025 to $400M by January 2026 — about seven months for a 4x — and roughly 20x year-over-year at the $400M mark.

Usage-based API pricing on its open-weight models, Le Chat consumer subscriptions (~$15–30/month tiers), and custom enterprise and sovereign contracts — private in-country deployments for governments and industrials like Airbus, BMW and ASML.

faqs.q: What Is Mistral's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: A €3 billion (~$3.5B) Series D in September 2026 valued Mistral at ~€21 billion (~$24B), up from €12B in September 2025. Total raised is roughly €6 billion since its 2023 founding, with ASML among the strategic backers.

Open weights. Mistral's models can be deployed inside national infrastructure and audited, which is the core requirement for sovereign-AI procurement in Europe — a wedge closed labs like OpenAI and Anthropic structurally cannot offer.
